items.title: Subscription-free embroidery design app
items.oneliner: Rust desktop app converts SVGs to PES and DST, replacing subscription embroidery software and supporting Bluetooth machine transfer.

items.title: Native Excalidraw for Apple devices
items.oneliner: SwiftUI wrapper turns Excalidraw into local macOS and iOS documents with iCloud sync, checkpoints, and realtime collaboration.

items.title: Managed agents that improve themselves
items.oneliner: Open-source agent runtime adds resumable execution, spend caps, approvals, and memory so repetitive workflows get cheaper over time.

items.title: JIT compiler for faster Rust iteration
items.oneliner: Function-level JIT for Rust runs code before full compilation, cutting edit-run latency for local development loops.

items.title: Running LLMs on old hardware
items.oneliner: Hands-on repo benchmarks and optimizes local LLM inference on TV boxes, phones, and old tablets with custom kernels.

items.title: Live systemd boot dependency tree
items.oneliner: Open-source console tool visualizes systemd jobs and dependencies during boot, making startup bottlenecks and failures immediately visible.

items.title: Linux fix for multi-GPU BAR mapping
items.oneliner: Deep hardware walkthrough plus kernel module shows how to map four 32 GB GPU BARs behind one PCIe switch.

items.title: PostgreSQL RCE exploit walkthrough
items.oneliner: Detailed exploit writeup traces a 22-year-old PostgreSQL type confusion bug into remote code execution with internals-level analysis.

items.title: Hijacking Samsung TV ad requests
items.oneliner: Practical mitmproxy walkthrough intercepts Samsung Smart Hub ad traffic and rewrites payloads, useful for network debugging and privacy experiments.

items.title: Advanced Lisp macros book online
items.oneliner: The full Let Over Lambda book is free online, offering concrete Common Lisp macro techniques you can apply immediately.
